chunks: Al-Bazofari from Humayd ibn al-Ziyad from al-Hasan ibn Sama'ah from al-Husayn ibn Hashim and Ibn Ribat from Safwan from al-Is ibn al-Qasim from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"The minimum that makes the concubine prohibited (from further sexual use) for the man is when she is with him, upon her child, if he touches her or strips her."

key_terms.عَلَى وَلَدِهِ: Upon her child (carrying the master's child)

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum act that frees a concubine in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the minimum threshold for a concubine's emancipation (itq) upon the master's sexual contact, specifically when she is carrying his child. It highlights the juristic principle that even minimal physical intimacy, such as touching or stripping, suffices to trigger her freedom, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the dignity of the mother of the child (umm al-walad).
